name: Lawrence County, SD
findings: Lawrence County has 133 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lawrence County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lawrence County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
